name: Public home
requirement_text_proposed: Visitor can view a published, responsive homepage with biography, featured work and clear calls to action

name: Profile
requirement_text_proposed: Public about page shows only owner-approved profile information

name: Project listing
requirement_text_proposed: Published projects support ordering, featured status and detail navigation

name: Project detail
requirement_text_proposed: Each published project has stable slug URL and engineering case study

name: Research listing
requirement_text_proposed: Published research entries show their actual statuses and categories

name: Research detail
requirement_text_proposed: Research page supports methods, datasets, results, limits and links

name: Education
requirement_text_proposed: Published education records display in configured order

name: Experience
requirement_text_proposed: Published work history displays appropriate dates and roles

name: Skills
requirement_text_proposed: Skills are grouped into editable categories and rendered publicly

name: Achievements
requirement_text_proposed: Certifications and achievements with optional verification URLs appear when published

name: Writing
requirement_text_proposed: Published articles have listing and individual pages; when no public articles exist, do not show Writing in primary navigation; CMS article capability remains in scope

name: Resume
requirement_text_proposed: Public resume download works when enabled, and is hidden when disabled

name: Contact
requirement_text_proposed: Validated contact message submission with feedback reflecting what the server actually accepted; email delivery is a separate outcome

name: Social links
requirement_text_proposed: Public social/profile links derive from admin settings

name: Search and filters
requirement_text_proposed: Visitor filters for projects/research/articles are enhancements; a design affordance does not authorize an implemented filter before data/API work is planned

name: Open source
requirement_text_proposed: Owner can publish notable public contributions

name: Speaking
requirement_text_proposed: Owner can publish talks/events and links

name: Admin access
requirement_text_proposed: Anonymous visitors cannot read private admin content or use admin mutations

name: Profile CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can edit and publish profile and site biography

name: Career CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can manage education and experience records

name: Project CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can create/update/reorder/archive projects

name: Research CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can create/update/archive research items and publications

name: Skills CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can manage skills and display categories

name: Credentials CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can manage certifications and achievements

name: Article CRUD
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can write rich-text articles and manage references

name: Media library
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can upload, reuse, replace and safely remove images/PDFs

name: Content publishing
requirement_text_proposed: Server-authoritative draft, authenticated private preview, publish, unpublish and archive; never show client-predicted Published/Saved as confirmed

name: Revision history
requirement_text_proposed: Important publishable content keeps restorable prior revisions

name: Settings
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can edit global site content, visibility and contact options

name: Featured content
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can choose which published items appear on homepage

name: SEO controls
requirement_text_proposed: Editable SEO title/description/OG image with published-only canonical indexing and applicable metadata; no private preview indexed

name: Inbox
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can review contact submissions with retention/deletion controls

name: Navigation order
requirement_text_proposed: Optional owner reorder of predefined homepage sections using a strict approved identifier allow-list, not arbitrary routes

name: Appearance
requirement_text_proposed: Safe theme-preset selection is deferred beyond Release 1; dark styling is the only approved Release 1 mode and any light token set remains dormant

name: Audit trail
requirement_text_proposed: Admin mutations and significant security events generate safe audit records

name: Scheduled publishing
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can schedule future publication

name: Auto-sync
requirement_text_proposed: Optional GitHub integrations can sync selected public repository metadata

name: Admin provisioning
requirement_text_proposed: Admin account is provisioned securely with no open registration

name: Password login
requirement_text_proposed: Valid password is required before login challenge

name: Email challenge
requirement_text_proposed: Short-lived one-use verified email challenge completes login

name: Secure sessions
requirement_text_proposed: Sessions expire, can be revoked and end on logout

name: Password recovery
requirement_text_proposed: Verified owner can complete secure password recovery

name: API authorization
requirement_text_proposed: Every private endpoint checks authenticated administrator status

name: Slug redirects
requirement_text_proposed: Old published URLs redirect appropriately when slugs change

name: No draft leakage
requirement_text_proposed: Anonymous SSR HTML, loaders, APIs, search index, feeds, sitemap and media URLs expose no draft/private data; private preview is no-store/noindex and authorized

name: Contact notifications
requirement_text_proposed: Verified admin receives notification when configured, without treating failed delivery as successful

name: Upload constraints
requirement_text_proposed: Server validates authorized upload type, size and ownership

name: Health probes
requirement_text_proposed: Application exposes safe liveness/readiness behavior for hosting

name: Error monitoring
requirement_text_proposed: Critical server/application errors are observable without secret leakage

name: Backups
requirement_text_proposed: Database backup and restore operations are documented and tested

name: Sitemap
requirement_text_proposed: Public published canonical URLs appear in an XML sitemap

name: User deletion/privacy
requirement_text_proposed: Admin can handle deletion and retention of contact messages

name: Accessibility
requirement_text_proposed: WCAG 2.2 AA target for public and admin; status messages, focus, zoom/reflow and accessible auth requirements; conformance only after real testing

name: Responsive design
requirement_text_proposed: Adapt phone through desktop; test 320/360/390/768/1024/1440/1920 CSS px reference widths, 200% text zoom, 320 CSS-px equivalent reflow

name: SEO rendering
requirement_text_proposed: Public core pages expose crawlable server-rendered content

name: Web performance
requirement_text_proposed: 75th percentile LCP <=2.5 s, INP <=200 ms, CLS <=0.1 as target

name: Password security
requirement_text_proposed: Industry-standard Argon2id password hashing; no plaintext storage

name: Session security
requirement_text_proposed: Secure HttpOnly cookie configuration, rotation/revocation and server storage

name: Authorization
requirement_text_proposed: Deny-by-default access to unpublished/admin resources

name: CSRF and XSS
requirement_text_proposed: Authenticated mutations CSRF-protected; rich content sanitized/safely rendered

name: Validation
requirement_text_proposed: All untrusted inputs validated on server; client validation enhances usability

name: Uploads
requirement_text_proposed: Server-side type/size checks; file storage outside application deploy filesystem

name: Data integrity
requirement_text_proposed: Foreign keys, uniqueness, migrations and transactions on critical writes

name: Backup recovery
requirement_text_proposed: Automated backups and documented tested isolated restoration

name: HTTPS
requirement_text_proposed: All production traffic served over HTTPS with appropriate redirects

name: Privacy
requirement_text_proposed: Collect minimum personal data; public visibility explicitly controlled

name: Reliability
requirement_text_proposed: 99.9% monthly availability aspirational target, not provider guarantee

name: Supportability
requirement_text_proposed: Structured logs, meaningful errors and production error monitoring

name: Maintainability
requirement_text_proposed: Modules separated by domain; documented interfaces and repeatable scripts

name: Compatibility
requirement_text_proposed: Current Chrome, Safari, Edge and Firefox; keyboard-only usage

name: Secrets
requirement_text_proposed: No credentials in repository or browser bundle

name: Deployment
requirement_text_proposed: Tested staging before controlled production release

name: Email resilience
requirement_text_proposed: Expired/used codes reject; notification failures handled clearly

name: Localization readiness
requirement_text_proposed: Unicode support, UTC stored dates and locale-aware rendering

name: Testability
requirement_text_proposed: P0 requirements have explicit, repeatable acceptance tests

name: Cost management
requirement_text_proposed: Infrastructure and provider usage monitored against budget
